summary.content:
Today's selection covers 110 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 72 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic Joins the A.I. Agent Race With Claude Duet
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: ClickFix has never been bigger, and AI tools are its most convincing lure yet
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 58 articles published in the last 24 hours
